source.content: Schema.DescribeFieldResult amount = Account.Amount__c.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals(12, amount.getDigits()); System.assertEquals(12, amount.getPrecision()); System.assertEquals(2, amount.getScale()); Schema.DescribeFieldResult help = Account.External_Id__c.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('External Id Help', help.getInlineHelpText()); System.assert(help.custom); Schema.DescribeFieldResult name = Account.Name.getDescribe(); System.assertEquals('Account Name', name.getLabel()); System.assertEquals('Name', name.getLocalName()); System.assertEquals('Name', name.getName()); System.assertEquals(Schema.SOAPType.STRING, name.getSOAPType()); System.assertEquals(Account.Name, name.getSObjectField()); System.assertEquals('Name', name.compoundFieldName); System.assertEquals(name.getLabel(), name.label); System.assertEquals(name.getLocalName(), name.localName); System.assertEquals(name.getName(), name.name); System.assertEquals(name.getSOAPType(), name.soapType); System.assertEquals(name.getSObjectField(), name.sObjectField); List<Schema.PicklistEntry> entries = Account.Rating.getDescribe().getPicklistValues(); System.assertEquals(2, entries.size()); Schema.PicklistEntry hot = entries.get(0); Schema.PicklistEntry cold = entries.get(1); System.assertEquals('Hot Label', hot.getLabel()); System.assertEquals('Hot Label', hot.label); System.assertEquals('Hot', hot.value); System.assert(hot.isActive()); System.assert(hot.active); System.assert(hot.isDefaultValue()); System.assert(hot.defaultValue); System.assertEquals('Cold', cold.value); System.assertEquals('Cold', cold.label); System.assert(!cold.isActive()); System.assert(!cold.active); System.assert(!cold.isDefaultValue()); System.assert(!cold.defaultValue);
